theorems.name: Submission.dph_lipschitz_smooth_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (m m' : ℕ) (G : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Λ : ℝ≥0) (A : Set (Eucl m)) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → LipschitzOnWith Λ G (thickening δ A) → ∃ (G' : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m') (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L G' ∧ EqOn G' G (thickening δ A) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Gj j)) ∧ (∀ j, LipschitzWith L (Gj j)) ∧ TendstoUniformly Gj G' atTop ∧ (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ thickening (δ / 2) A, ‖fderiv ℝ (Gj j) x‖ ≤ Λ) ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (α : SimonMultiIndex k m') (z : Eucl m') (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → (∀ x ∈ thickening ε A, G x ∈ thickening ε (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k)) → ∀ i, i ∉ range α → G x i = z i) → (∀ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) y (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (α j) (1 : ℝ)) = 0) → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ x ∈ thickening r A, ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (Gj j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj j) x) = 0
